videos.title: Winx Club – The Magic Is Back
Blue Peter: Secret Santa Showdown, Greg James and Festive Crafts.
Gardeners' World Winter Specials
videos.description: Winter may be closing in, but Adam Frost has thrown on his warm coat and is sharing some practical jobs and seasonal inspiration to keep gardens thriving through the colder months. From planting shrubs and creating a striking winter container to laying a brick path, there's plenty to be getting on with in preparation for spring. In Hertfordshire, Ashley Edwards is given an exclusive tour of a stunning walled garden. Rachel de Thame reveals her secrets for growing spectacular dahlias, while Joe Swift discovers an extraordinary garden in Dorset bursting with beauty and inspiring plant combinatio

videos.title: Life in a Cottage Garden with Carol Klein.
videos.description: Plantswoman Carol Klein shares with us a year in her garden at Glebe Cottage in north Devon. Carol has looked after her garden for over 30 years, each with its own rewards and delights, as well as problems and challenges. Follow Carol as her garden grows, flourishes, dies and is reborn. The first episode covers January and February. The frosts have not yet released their grip on the garden, and the devastation of a hard winter is scattered all around. There is much to do – cutting back, preparing the soil and planting garlic. The first green shoots of the year begin to appear as drifts of snow

videos.title: Naturewatch
videos.description: Nature is full of extraordinary surprises, and Chris Packham, Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin are uncovering some of its more curious mysteries. Why do foxes' eyes shine in the dark? How did fish farts almost cause an international diplomatic incident? Does ivy really damage the trees it climbs? And how exactly do sea anemones deliver their sting? Together, they get to the bottom of these fascinating wildlife questions, with plenty of surprising discoveries along the way. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Film: Whisky Galore! (1948)
videos.description: Classic Ealing comedy about a whisky-laden ship that runs aground off the coast of the Outer Hebrides during the Second World War. The local islanders have depleted their supply of the amber nectar and are overjoyed at the thought of stocking up again. But it is Sunday, and the teetotallers object to making free with the unexpected cargo. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden.
videos.description: Marcus makes plans to expand the smallholding's herb patch. A trip to Gloucestershire to see the UK's largest herb collection shows that even someone as experienced as Marcus can still learn a lot about ingredients. Back at the smallholding, gardener Anatoli shows Marcus how to look after the bees and harvest the honey, and Marcus brings in some junior chefs to get inspired in the way the kitchen garden is inspiring him. Once the new herbs are in place, Marcus cooks up a herby feast for the people who have helped him along the way. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Homes Under the Hammer
videos.description: A beautiful building in Bath. Martin meets a couple who have bought a flat in a period, listed building, and luckily for them, they own the flat below too. In West Yorkshire, Martel meets two pals hoping to turn four flats into six! (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Film: Kelly's Heroes
videos.description: Zweiter Weltkrieg: Per Zufall erfährt US-Soldat Kelly (Clint Eastwood), dass die Deutschen in einer Bank in Lothringen einen Goldschatz deponiert haben. Mit einem Haufen schräger Vögel (u. a. Telly Savalas, Harry Dean Stanton und Donald Sutherland) gibt er dem Kitzel des Verbotenen nach und bricht in geklauten Panzern ins Feindesland auf…\n\nDer satirische Mix aus „Das dreckige Dutzend“ (1967) und den Italowestern jener Jahre ist ein schräger Spaß mit tollen Thrillereffekten und großen Explosionen. Passend dazu veralbert der Soundtrack von Lalo Schifrin („Mission: Impossible“) den „Morricone“-

videos.title: Final Score
videos.description: Jason Mohammad and guests bring you all the goals, latest news, analysis, reaction and interviews from the afternoon's biggest football matches. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Film: A Bridge Too Far
videos.description: Im September 1944 springen in den Niederlanden 35.000 alliierte Fallschirmjäger hinter den feindlichen Linien ab, um sechs Rheinbrücken zu besetzen. Doch im Zielgebiet liegen starke deutsche Panzerverbände. Das Unternehmen „Market Garden“ endet in einem Fiasko, bei dem 17.000 Soldaten sterben…\n\n„Gandhi“-Regisseur Attenborough († 2014) drehte mit Stars in Kompaniestärke: Sean Connery, Michael Caine, Anthony Hopkins, Hardy Krüger, Robert Redford und andere standen für das aufwändige Schlachtengemälde stramm.

videos.title: U2 at the BBC
videos.description: A selection of U2's most memorable BBC appearances, including early songs such as their first Top 40 hit, Fire, on Top of the Pops in 1981; I Will Follow from a 1982 appearance on teen magazine show Something Else; and Two Hearts Beat as One from a rarely seen visit to The Kenny Everett Television Show in 1983. Other highlights include their 2011 set at Glastonbury – which featured classic tracks such as Sunday Bloody Sunday, Where the Streets Have No Name and Pride (In the Name of Love) – and a 2009 performance of Vertigo that wasn't just at the BBC, but on it, with the band singing from the

videos.title: U2: Live on the BBC at Tate Modern
videos.description: Global titans U2 perform at the Tate Modern in London for a truly unique live collaboration of music and art. Fifty years since the Dublin band formed at secondary school, the legendary four-piece return with their 16th album, Carnaval de Luz. For one night, they perform songs from the record and classic favourites, including Pride (In the Name of Love), Beautiful Day and With or Without You, visually accompanied by 77 Million Paintings, an artwork by producer, artist and long-time friend and collaborator of the band Brian Eno. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: U2: Tracks Of My Years
videos.description: The four members of U2 – Bono, The Edge, Adam Clayton and Larry Mullen Jr – join Vernon Kay to choose ten songs from their lives as they release their new album, Carnaval De Luz, their first in nine years. In a conversation going right back to forming at Mount Temple Comprehensive School in Dublin in 1976, the band discuss their early musical days, including Larry's other musical endeavours before the band, Edge's DIY guitar-making and Adam's discovery of The Stranglers whilst working in London in 1977. They also tell Vernon about the unique chemistry they discovered they had as a band, and ho

videos.title: Bill's Included
videos.description: Bill's exciting new life comes crashing down when he learns that his lodgers have given themselves nicknames but left him out. Hurt, Bill ramps up his eccentricities in the hope of providing the inspiration for a new moniker, only for his odd behaviour to confirm the students' suspicion that they're living with a weirdo. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Glorious Gardens from Above
videos.description: The county of Yorkshire is the setting for Christine Walkden's balloon tour of Britain. At Scampston Hall we discover two superstar garden designers and meet young gardener Nathan, who is just starting out. At York Gate Garden, Christine catches up with an old friend and we discover the Yorkshireman who was the father of aviation. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Countryfile
videos.description: Charlotte Smith and Sean Fletcher are in the Ceiriog Valley in north Wales, meeting former clinical vet Claire Whittle, who took on an upland farm two years ago. Charlotte finds out why Claire made the leap into farming and what regenerative farming means to her, before helping with health and pregnancy checks on her cattle. Sean gets stuck into a cow pat to explore the hidden world of dung beetles and helps plant trees in a new agroforestry field. Meanwhile, Tom investigates changes that could be coming for the game bird shooting industry. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Landward
videos.description: Dougie is at Loch Tay in Perthshire, where he gets an insight into the lives or our Iron Age ancestors and visits a reconstructed crannog at a prime lochside location. Arlene is in the Carse of Gowrie to find out how the community won the right to buy and restore a historic orchard. Rosie is searching for Scottish truffles on the Isle of Bute, Shahbaz is in the Cowal Peninsula to meet the couple rewilding their dairy farm, and Anne is in Angus, where she meets the chocolatier using locally grown berries in her confectionery. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
videos.description: Matt Tebbutt delves into the archives to bring an array of delicious recipes from some favourite Saturday Kitchen chefs. Alison Roman serves up her date and caramelised lemon pot roast chicken with a herb, garlic and pistachio salad. Owen Morgan brings along a taste of Spain, combining the flavours of mountain and sea for his chicken and seafood Spanish rice finished with a sherry and garlic aioli. Jamie Oliver takes to the hobs with an alternative to a traditional Christmas lunch: roasted venison loin wrapped in prosciutto, with a rustic celeriac mash finished with a chocolate and red wine sa

videos.title: Film: White Christmas
videos.description: Bob Wallace (Bing Crosby) und Phil Davis (Danny Kaye), zwei erfolgreiche Entertainer, organisieren eine rauschende Revue, um ein Wintersporthotel in Vermont vor der Pleite zu bewahren… \n\nNach einer Operette von Irving Berlin. Höhepunkt: Bing Crosby intoniert seinen Evergreen „White Christmas“.

videos.title: Why Sinkholes Collapse
videos.description: On 24 September 2025, the main road outside one of Bangkok's major hospitals collapsed. The giant sinkhole, the size of two tennis courts, snapped water pipes, ripped down power lines, and swallowed two vehicles. During the day, it continued to grow, threatening the foundations of the hospital and forcing close to a thousand staff and patients to evacuate the building. Ampan Vimonvattana, vice dean of Vajira Hospital, witnessed the collapse: "The earth swallowed everything... it pulled the road surface, the soil, anything on top. Even the electrical poles got dragged down. It was really scary.

videos.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
videos.description: Lucy Worsley travels to Venice, where she is given the keys to the Doge's Palace, a multi-purpose building that controlled Venice's empire for a thousand years. She has a close shave in the dreaded Council of Ten's torture chamber, discovers a 24-carat gold staircase that leads to one of the biggest rooms in Europe, and encounters hidden doors and secret messages. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: New: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing.
videos.description: Paul and Bob are in Hampshire to fish both the River Beaulieu and the adjoining Solent. They're here to catch mullet and later take a boat trip up the Solent to try for a smooth hound. The Beaulieu is one of only a handful of rivers privately owned in the UK. It's been property of the Montagu family since the 18th century, and Paul and Bob have been given special permission to fish here. Later, they are joined by their doctor friend Anand Patel for an evening tipple and an update on their health. Paul is keen to discuss his most recent diagnosis, while Bob asks Anand to examine his feet for a

videos.title: A Course Called Ireland
videos.description: As their adventure nears its end, Bill still finds time to terrify Tom with his driving. A stormy round with NFL star Jason Kelce brings refuge in a stone shelter on the 7th, complete with pints and sausage rolls. In Dublin, Bill puts Tom in the spotlight for a change, before the pair reach the Giant's Causeway and reflect on a journey that became about far more than golf. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Film: Saving Private Ryan
videos.description: 6. Juni 1944. D-Day. Blutjunge, vor Angst kotzende US-Soldaten landen in der Normandie, Kampfabschnitt Omaha - ein Inferno. Die GIs sterben wie die Fliegen. Hier gibt es keine Deckung vorm deutschen Feuer, keine Ordnung, nur endloses Grauen, einen Strand, der sich rot färbt vom Blut. Bis Captain Miller (Tom Hanks) und die Überlebenden seiner Kompanie eine Bresche in den Verteidigungswall sprengen. Jetzt sind die anderen dran mit Sterben.\n\nEin paar Tage später. Miller soll mit einer Gruppe von sieben Männern den Soldaten James Ryan (Matt Damon) aufspüren. Ryan steckt irgendwo im Kriegschaos h

videos.title: Question Time
videos.description: With energy bills set to soar 26% for millions of households from January, what can the UK government do to help people with rising costs? Fiona Bruce presents an hour of topical debate from Clydebank, debating energy bills and oil and gas extraction, claims of avoidable deaths at NHS Grampian following accusations by a whistleblower surgeon, a drop in immigration, and trust in politics. Featuring the SNP's Stephen Flynn MSP, Labour's Melanie Ward MP, Reform UK Scotland's Malcolm Offord MSP, Scottish Greens' Holly Bruce MSP, and Scottish Conservative Russell Findlay. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Honey
videos.description: When an old friend returns, Martha faces the danger of exposure, forcing her to confess all to Kurt and make a risky decision to trust him. They must both keep Kamilla onside, even whilst keeping secrets from her and one another. Fuelled by both his complicated entanglements with Martha and Kurt and an effort to outmanoeuvre her, Friedrich makes a drastic move to catch Martha out. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Blue Planet III
videos.description: A journey into the last great frontier on earth. Beneath the ocean's surface lies a vast, largely unknown realm of deep coral reefs, towering mountains, volcanoes and hydrothermal vents, all part of the largest living space on the planet. Once thought to be empty and inaccessible, this hidden world is now yielding its secrets. New technology, including remotely operated vehicles (ROVs), is taking us further into this realm than ever before, revealing an astonishing abundance of life and some of the most exciting discoveries of our time. In the Pacific, a young female argonaut, no bigger than a

videos.title: Match of the Day
videos.description: On a big Sunday of Premier League action, Arsenal face Manchester City, and it's Everton v Liverpool in the Merseyside derby. Brighton take on Newcastle, Crystal Palace play Hull City, Bournemouth go to Fulham, and Sunderland host Tottenham at the Stadium of Light. Presented by Gabby Logan. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Flog It!
videos.description: This edition comes from Dover Castle in Kent, where antiques experts James Lewis and Catherine Southon search for items to take off to auction. James unearths a silver owl inkwell, and Catherine discovers an alabaster bust. Paul Martin delves into the history of the English Channel. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: New: House of Games
videos.description: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Matt Baker, Charley Marlowe, Rose Matafeo and Jack Rooke take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard? (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Strictly It Takes Two
videos.description: Ellie Taylor kicks off the week by exclusively chatting to the latest couple to be eliminated from the competition. Also, Friday's all-star panel of Strictly alumni return to break down all the weekend action from the ballroom. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Global Eye
videos.description: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode, BBC Ukrainian Service reporter Anastasiya Gribanova sets out to uncover who killed her family. Following Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, her relatives, like countless others, were forced to confront painful questions of loyalty and identity. Anastasiya's mother, born in Russia, sided with the

videos.title: Mastermind
videos.description: Four more contenders face the black chair under the spotlight and the ticking clock in an attempt to become the next Mastermind champion. Clive Myrie hosts and asks the questions on specialist subjects, which this time are King John, the 19th-century designer and artist William Morris, the musical Cabaret and the professional wrestler Bret Hart. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Only Connect
videos.description: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts the quiz where knowledge only gets you so far – the vital extra ingredients are logic and lateral thinking. It's the third appearance of both teams, and a place in the next round is at stake. All they have to do is establish what connects a series of apparently random clues, such as ray, storey, underground storage and symbols of married status. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
videos.description: Lucy Worsley has been given the keys to the spectacular palace of Versailles in France. The palace is huge – there are 2,000 rooms to explore, and everywhere Lucy discovers gold and more gold. This is one of the biggest and most ostentatious palaces she has ever seen. Lucy is here to find out more about France's most notorious queen, Marie Antoinette, who arrived at Versailles from Austria aged just 14 to marry the heir to the French throne. Her story is one of money, sex, power and snowy white goats. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
videos.description: Constables Bert and Harry are on patrol near Portadown when they see a suspicious car. As they approach, it speeds off, and a high speed, white-knuckle chase along narrow country road ensues. The dangerous driver rips through towns and villages, at times narrowly missing pedestrians. Back in the cop car, Bert and Harry stay calm, while Stephen is terrified. It all comes to an unexpected end. In Belfast, there has been a mass brawl, but when the team arrive, there are only two men left. Their behaviour leads them down two very different paths. Later, Dave and Owen are on the beat dealing with t

videos.title: The Misadventures of Romesh Ranganathan.
videos.description: In the final part of his African odyssey, Romesh travels to the fourth largest island in the world – Madagascar. But like most people, when he brings to mind this former French colony in the Indian Ocean, his only reference is an animated Disney film. Romesh embarks on a mission, guided by exuberant diving instructor Bic, to find out what Madagascar has to offer the uninitiated – apart from cartoon dancing lemurs. In the chaotic capital of Antananarivo, Bic samples a popular soup made from an eye-watering delicacy, Rom discovers that local taxi drivers have an intoxicating way of economising o
